strategySummary: Secret and environment strategy is design-only. No credentials, secrets, tokens or environment variables are configured. eBay sandbox must be server-only. Secrets must never be committed, exposed in frontend, stored in fixtures or printed in logs. Seller passwords must never be requested or stored by IMNOVA. Production remains blocked. OAuth, token exchange, token storage, read-only connection, draft creation and publication remain blocked.

serverOnlyPolicy.notes: Admin UI may show readiness/status only. Secret values, token values, seller passwords and credential values must never be exposed to the browser, fixtures, logs or Git history.

blockedWorkflows.reason: Real secret configuration is not allowed in this design-only loop.
No real environment variables may be configured in this loop.
OAuth implementation requires approved secret and environment strategy.
Auth URL generation requires approved environment and credential strategy.
Callback route requires approved server-only token handling.
Token exchange requires approved token handling strategy.
Token storage requires approved secure storage strategy.
Read-only connection requires OAuth, tokens and approved server-only access.
Draft mapping remains blocked until connection and listing gates are approved.
Production remains blocked until sandbox validation and human approval.

requiredHumanActions: Confirm no secrets may be committed to Git.
Confirm no secrets may be stored in fixtures.
Confirm no secrets may be exposed to frontend.
Confirm IMNOVA must never request or store seller passwords.
Approve a future OAuth scaffold loop only after secret strategy is approved.
Keep production, draft creation and publication blocked.
